title: scM&T-seq
scope: Angermueller 2016 scM&T-seq implementation represented by the assigned Illumina scM&T-seq row and its additional poster depictions. Captured poly(A) RNA and genomic DNA from the same isolated cell are physically separated and independently prepared and sequenced, producing matched transcriptome and methylome data. Smart-seq2, scBS-seq and G&T-seq are components/context, not additional target methods. Neighboring assay rows and the standalone right-hand structural illustration are outside scope. Shared sequencing/alignment captions are resolved into independent branch operations, with joint attribution carried by single-cell sample identity rather than an invented molecular linkage or pooling step.

The two final datasets remain separate but paired by their common cell identity; no additional cross-assay workflow is admitted.
